module: # Reviewed boundary corrections for config/main/ledger.tsv. Apply with:
# One row re-partitions [start, end) in (module, block): it replaces every ledger entry
# whose address is in [start, end) with an entry at each "cuts" address. start and end must
# be existing entry addresses (the left/right edges are fixed by the neighbouring entries);
# cuts is strictly increasing, all within [start, end), and cuts[0] == start. A cut whose
# address already exists keeps that row (and its status); a new cut is generated as
# func_<addr>/D_<addr>. See the module docstring in tools/ledger/reconcile.py for the full
# contract, and tools/ledger/fragments.py to find candidate regions.
# This file is empty (no active override) until a real region is traced and reviewed.
# Do NOT add one speculatively: a boundary change reshapes the denominator and orphans any
# matched work at a removed address. Always verify the real prologue/return boundaries from
# the disassembly of the TARGET image (baserom/main.nso — the update) first.
